subject: Re: travel plans
text: Hey, I looked again at the bus schedule we talked about. I still want to come, but I suddenly remembered I have a tutoring shift on Friday evening that I can’t move. If we leave Thursday afternoon instead, I can finish work early and meet you at the station. Let me know if that works or whether the original plan is easier for everyone else. Sorry to scramble things—I’ll handle my own ticket if the timing changes.
